_about: Curated probable-cause knowledge base. The model may only choose a cause id from this file, and only one listed as applying to the defect type it found. Wording here is returned verbatim, so edit it here rather than in code. Urgency: low, medium, high, urgent. An urgency of null means 'derive from the defect severity'.

dust_accumulation.title: Dust and airborne particulate build-up
dust_accumulation.explanation: An even film of dust, sand or pollution residue settles on the glass and reduces the light reaching the cells. It builds fastest in dry, windy or industrial locations and between rains.
verify_with: Compare output before and after cleaning
Inspect the full array for a uniform film
dust_accumulation.action: Clean with soft water and a non-abrasive brush. Set a cleaning interval based on local dust conditions.

bird_droppings.title: Bird droppings
bird_droppings.explanation: Droppings are opaque and localised. Unlike an even dust film, they can fully shade individual cells and force them to heat up, which can develop into a hotspot if left in place.
verify_with: Infrared thermography of the affected cells
bird_droppings.action: Remove promptly. Consider bird deterrents if the array is used as a perch.

organic_growth.title: Moss, lichen or algae growth
organic_growth.explanation: Biological growth takes hold where moisture and dirt collect, usually along the lower frame edge in humid or shaded locations.
verify_with: Close visual inspection of frame edges
organic_growth.action: Clean gently without scraping the glass. Improve drainage or tilt if growth recurs.

edge_soiling_low_tilt.title: Edge soiling from water pooling
edge_soiling_low_tilt.explanation: On shallow tilt angles, rainwater pools against the lower frame and deposits dirt as it evaporates, forming a band that repeatedly shades the bottom row of cells.
verify_with: Check for a band along the lower edge
edge_soiling_low_tilt.action: Clean the lower edge. Consider a steeper tilt or frameless edges if the band keeps returning.

encapsulant_browning.title: Encapsulant yellowing or browning
encapsulant_browning.explanation: The EVA layer that bonds the cells to the glass degrades under years of ultraviolet exposure and heat, turning yellow or brown and transmitting less light. It is an ageing effect and usually progresses slowly.
verify_with: I-V curve test to measure power loss
Compare with the module's rated output and age
encapsulant_browning.action: Monitor output over time. Replace the module if power loss exceeds the warranty threshold.

metallization_corrosion.title: Corrosion of cell contacts or ribbons
metallization_corrosion.explanation: Moisture that has entered the module corrodes the metal contacts and interconnect ribbons, showing as dark or discoloured lines and patches. Resistance rises and output falls as it spreads.
metallization_corrosion.action: Schedule replacement. Check neighbouring modules for the same moisture exposure.

localized_overheating.title: Localised overheating
localized_overheating.explanation: A cell or connection that runs persistently hotter than its neighbours discolours the materials around it. This is often the early stage of a burn mark.
localized_overheating.action: Confirm with thermography before the next inspection cycle. Replace the module if a hotspot is confirmed.

mechanical_impact.title: Mechanical impact
mechanical_impact.explanation: Hail, stones, falling branches or tools can crack the glass and the cells beneath it. A radiating or star pattern around a single point strongly suggests impact.
verify_with: Check for recent hail or storm events
mechanical_impact.action: Isolate the module. Cracked glass lets moisture in and can become an electrical safety hazard. Replace and file an insurance claim if weather caused it.

installation_or_handling_stress.title: Installation or handling stress
installation_or_handling_stress.explanation: Over-tightened clamps, walking on the module, or rough transport bends the panel and cracks cells, often without breaking the glass. Cracks near clamp points suggest this cause.
installation_or_handling_stress.action: Correct the mounting. Replace the module if cracks affect output.

thermal_or_structural_stress.title: Thermal cycling or structural stress
thermal_or_structural_stress.explanation: Daily heating and cooling, or a frame that flexes under wind load, repeatedly stresses the laminate until cells crack or layers separate.
verify_with: Inspect the mounting structure for flex or distortion
thermal_or_structural_stress.action: Stiffen or correct the mounting. Replace affected modules.

hotspot_cell_mismatch.title: Hotspot from a damaged or mismatched cell
hotspot_cell_mismatch.explanation: A cracked or weaker cell cannot carry the same current as the rest of its string, so it dissipates energy as heat instead of producing it. Sustained heating burns the surrounding materials.
hotspot_cell_mismatch.action: Disconnect and replace the module. Burn marks indicate sustained high temperature and are a fire risk.

hotspot_partial_shading.title: Hotspot from persistent partial shading
hotspot_partial_shading.explanation: When part of a module stays shaded for long periods, the shaded cells are driven into reverse bias and heat up while the rest of the string pushes current through them.
hotspot_partial_shading.action: Remove the source of shade. Replace the module if burn damage is present.

bypass_diode_failure.title: Failed bypass diode
bypass_diode_failure.explanation: Bypass diodes route current around a shaded or damaged section of cells. If one fails, that section can no longer be bypassed and overheats. Damage often follows a third of the module, matching one diode's section.
verify_with: Bypass diode test at the junction box
bypass_diode_failure.action: Disconnect the module. Replace the diode or the module. A failed diode is a fire risk.

connection_fault.title: High-resistance connection
connection_fault.explanation: A poor solder joint or loose ribbon connection has high electrical resistance and heats under load. Damage concentrated on a busbar or at the junction box end suggests this cause.
connection_fault.action: Disconnect immediately. High-resistance joints can arc and start fires.

external_obstruction.title: Shade from a nearby object
external_obstruction.explanation: A building, pole, antenna, tree or new vegetation casts a shadow across part of the array. Shading from growth or construction often appears gradually over months.
verify_with: Shading survey at several times of day
Check for recent construction or plant growth
external_obstruction.action: Trim vegetation or relocate the obstruction where possible. Otherwise review string layout.

microcracks_with_moisture.title: Micro-cracks reacting with moisture
microcracks_with_moisture.explanation: Snail trails are dark, winding lines that follow invisible micro-cracks in a cell. Moisture reaches the cracks and reacts with the cell's silver paste, making the crack pattern visible.
verify_with: Electroluminescence imaging to map the cracks
microcracks_with_moisture.action: Monitor output. Replace if power loss is significant; the cracks themselves will not heal.

moisture_ingress.title: Moisture ingress
moisture_ingress.explanation: Failed edge seals or a damaged backsheet let water vapour into the laminate, where it weakens bonding between layers and corrodes the cell contacts.
moisture_ingress.action: Replace the module. Moisture inside a module is an electrical insulation risk.

manufacturing_defect.title: Manufacturing defect
manufacturing_defect.explanation: Poor lamination, contamination trapped during production, or inconsistent materials show up as bubbles, separation or uneven colour, often early in the module's life.
verify_with: Compare with other modules from the same batch
manufacturing_defect.action: Document with photographs and file a warranty claim with the manufacturer.

undetermined.title: Cause not determinable from the image
undetermined.explanation: The visible evidence is not specific enough to attribute a probable cause. An on-site inspection is needed.
verify_with: On-site inspection by a qualified technician
undetermined.action: Inspect the module in person before deciding on any action.
